title: Prove the least subfield for determinant norm witnesses (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof and construction with finite exact corroboration. For K=F_q and L=F_(q^d), the least intermediate-field degree supporting every nonzero norm target, and hence every retained coefficient-unit determinant request, is exactly

```text
e_* = product over primes ell dividing q-1 of ell^v_ell(d)
restricted norm image from F_(q^e) = (K*)^(d/e)
sufficient degrees = divisors e of d with e_* dividing e
```

From a supplied certified primitive element, the new constructor attains that least field with at most q-1 target comparisons after its initial powers. A new F3 degree-six example has a norm-two witness t^91 in F9, while every nonzero base scalar has norm one. Literal 6-by-6 and 18-by-18 multiplication matrices both have determinant two.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit apoursh / PR5663 and PR5668 for the determinant-witness contract and arithmetic seam; Ali Romman for recognition and coefficient-field arithmetic; Nick Petalas / PR5252 for the etale norm interface; David Ganz and the retained tensor-atlas lineage. Finite-field norm, subfield and cyclic-group facts are classical; no global literature-priority claim is made. Predecessor theorems are cited premises, not audit deliverables. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

Before, the retained norm-witness routine scans the residue field and the transport package explicitly leaves its enumerative cost open. After, the scoped theorem identifies the exact least uniform subfield and supplies an attaining constructor under a primitive-generator contract. It does not eliminate the retained full arithmetic tables or price primitive-element discovery.

- 12,900 enumerated cyclic images for 2,560 supplied order/degree pairs.
- Eighteen literal field presentations, 41 base-field domains, 74 intermediate fields, 7,764 norm evaluations and 2,494 attaining witnesses. Prime and extension base fields are included. Full generator cycles certify the fixtures; separate conjugate products check constructed norms.
- Seventeen invalid inputs reject, four discriminating formula fixtures pass, and both explicit determinant maps give two.
- Warning-strict development-mode direct normal/optimized commands pass locally in 5.435 and 6.316 seconds, with equal reports. Both registered checks pass; each is below its 180-second bound. These are local replay durations, not a runtime speedup claim.
- Metadata/pins, AST/function-size inspection, whitespace, committed bytes, executable modes and source-history availability pass at head 4d0af81c97a1baad8c7bf1228b189f966a76c3d7.
- Official committed export/input integrity and both normal/optimized replays from a read-only Git-free export pass with PATH=/nonexistent. All eight exported files retain their bytes and read-only modes. The verifier generates its hash-bound report; no receipt is hand-written.

From the repository root, CPython 3.12 and standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -X dev -B research/norm-witness-subfield/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -X dev -B research/norm-witness-subfield/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/norm-witness-subfield
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/norm-witness-subfield --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Any clean CPython 3.12 installation may replace that interpreter path. Expected markers are PASS_NORM_WITNESS_SUBFIELD, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. PROOF.md contains the universal proof; finite execution does not establish its universal quantifiers independently.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The minimum is over intermediate fields containing K, rather than arbitrary subsets or linear subspaces. Generator discovery/certification, large-q discrete logarithms, efficient embeddings and full-table replacement remain separate costs. The executable is bounded to polynomial quotients of degree at most eight and at most 4,096 elements; the theorem covers every finite base field and extension degree.

No physical/native/rounded supplier, complete invoice, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker build is supplied or run. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Supply a primitive element in one named determinant consumer without a full-field traversal. First fix its residue presentation and target set, then charge discovery or certification separately. A large-degree native consumer is missing.
- Replace full residue tables under a complete transport contract. First specify polynomial-basis arithmetic, stored coefficient maps and embedding requirements. The least-field theorem alone does not pay these costs.

## Related open work

The completion refresh inspected this account's fifteen open PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this PR. The fourteen others, PR6418–6421 and PR6423–6432, study different objects or workloads; none targets this least intermediate-field norm-witness degree. Focused current subfield and norm-witness searches likewise located no other open PR studying this quantity. No common numerical endpoint was identified and no extra computation checked another contribution.

Merged PR5663/5668 are the cited interface predecessors. Merged PR6004 computes presentation-change determinants, and PR6303 changes row elimination; neither computes this least-field quantity.

The completed checks were read once; separate run metadata confirms completed success and the matching head.

Hosted replay runs both registered normal/optimized commands and source metadata validation. All local checks listed above also passed. Hosted success certifies the bounded replay, not independent mathematical acceptance of the universal written proof. Primitive-generator discovery, physical implementation, supplier admission and the five selected framework assumptions retain their stated status. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated package. Seven new files and an opt-in replay; shared code, frozen predecessors and the selected frontier are unchanged.
